brand.name: BRANDKING
brand.evidence: Fictional demo identity. No Instagram profile was analyzed.

caption:
Give every swipe a reason to exist.

Start with one reader problem, turn it into a useful takeaway, and use your brand identity to connect the sequence. Save this checklist for your next content brief.

#CarouselDesign #BrandIdentity #ContentDesign

slides.headline: Make every swipe count.
slides.alt: Dark green cover with ivory headline and three overlapping editorial cards.
slides.visual_prompt: A restrained three-card editorial metaphor; ivory, lime and warm neutral. No generated lettering.

slides.headline: One slide. One useful idea.
slides.body: A crowded slide asks readers to do the editing. Give each idea room.
slides.alt: Ivory editorial slide explaining why each slide should carry one idea.
slides.visual_prompt: Open ivory field, left-aligned headline and generous negative space. Short lime rule.

slides.headline: Turn attention into understanding.
slides.alt: Two comparison panels contrast a vague promise with a practical next step.
slides.visual_prompt: Two side-by-side editorial panels, lime and ivory; compare two ideas without fake metrics.

slides.headline: Build a clear sequence.
slides.alt: Three numbered rows present a problem, an insight and an action.
slides.visual_prompt: Three clean numbered horizontal cards on charcoal; identical alignment and ample gutters.

slides.headline: Check the essentials.
slides.alt: A three-item pre-publication checklist on an ivory background.
slides.visual_prompt: Minimal checklist with three dark rounded rows. Keep all content clear and readable.

slides.headline: Start with your reader.
slides.body: Choose one problem. Leave people with something they can use.
slides.alt: Closing green slide with a practical summary and a lime save prompt.
slides.visual_prompt: Quiet green closing composition with a single lime action panel and fixed dark footer.
